Book correction: The book prints the first equation of 6(i) as x + 4x - 2z = 0. It should read x + 4y - 2z = 0: each equation of the system has x, y and z, and the answer key's \{(0, 0, 0)\} fits this equation (|A| = 36 \neq 0). Even taken literally (5x - 2z = 0) the determinant is -8 \neq 0, so the answer, only the trivial solution, is the same.
